source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed building fire-safety checks

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Clearly indicate the date, time, and location of the failed checks.
3. Document the specific areas or items that failed, providing details about each.
4. Note the nature of the failure, such as missing or nonfunctional safety equipment.
5. Take photos or videos of the issues, clearly labeling them with the date and location.
6. Include observations regarding potential hazards and risks identified during the inspection.
7. List the safety standards or regulations that the building failed to meet.
8. Record any written or verbal communications with the property owner or management regarding the failed checks.
9. Suggest corrective actions and a timeline for their completion.
10. Compile all documentation, including inspection report forms, photos, and correspondence, in an organized folder.
11. Ensure the documentation is stored securely and backed up electronically.
12. Inform the appropriate authorities or regulatory bodies about the failed checks, escalating the matter as necessary.
13. Keep copies of all documentation on hand for
